theme.aesthetic: Futuristic, Premium, Apple + Linear + Vercel vibe. Strict avoidance of common purple AI theme. No centered Inter-on-white.

gradients.background_glow: radial-gradient(circle at top center, rgba(0,229,255,0.15) 0%, transparent 50%)

design_system.spacing: Use p-8 to p-12 for internal card padding to ensure premium feel. Use gap-8 to gap-12 in bento grids.
design_system.borders: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.08) for structure. Avoid heavy shadows; prefer glow or 1px tracing.

animations.hover_state: Cards lift up (-translate-y-1) with increased border brightness.
animations.micro_interactions: Buttons scale down to 0.98 on active state.

components_guidance.hero: H1 with gradient text. Dual CTA (Get Started Primary cyan, Watch demo secondary glass). Background must feature a subtle cyan/blue glowing orb. No heavy overlays.
components_guidance.trusted_by: Logo strip with 10+ logos. Grayscale, opacity-40, infinite seamless marquee.
components_guidance.features: 4-6 bento grid cards. Each card uses glassmorphism and contains a cyan Lucide icon.
components_guidance.how_it_works: 3-step process, linear flow, using connecting lines or numbered glowing badges.
components_guidance.models_supported: Dense grid of tools (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Midjourney, etc). Cards have a subtle inner glow.
components_guidance.pricing: 3 tiers (Free, Pro, Enterprise). Pro tier has a 1px solid #00E5FF border and a subtle cyan drop-shadow glow.
components_guidance.testimonials: Carousel or grid of user reviews. Uses avatar images. Text should feel personal and authentic.
components_guidance.faq: Uses shadcn Accordion. Minimalist styling, border-b only.
components_guidance.contact: Form taking Name, Email, Message. Focus rings must be #00E5FF.
components_guidance.footer: Multi-column links, muted text, newsletter email capture input.
components_guidance.auth_pages: Sign Up / Sign In. Center glass card on dark cyan wavy abstract background. Include Google Auth button.
components_guidance.dashboard: Minimal authenticated state. Sidebar nav. Welcome back user text. A simple bento grid for placeholder stats.

images.description: Abstract blue and white art for deep space hero feel
Abstract blue glowing dots for AI models section
Dark teal wavy shapes for auth page backdrop
Minimal white logo for trusted by strip

testing.requirements: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case.
